title: Networks in Bare Metal
shortDescription: How the Bare Metal server network works: network interfaces, aggregated interfaces (LAG), VLANs, and their types
metaDescription: Learn how the network configuration of Bare Metal servers in VK Cloud works: network interfaces and link aggregation (LAG), VLANs and the 802.1Q standard, Sprut and L2Only VLAN types, addressing, and internet access.
